checklist.text: Ideation round 2 under Captain amendment 1 replaces the outcome; design it as a removal rather than a generator.
Say which factual summary lines are saved, which unobservable judgments stay FO-written, what the gate carries, and which workflow words/checker rules are removed, with word and line counts.
State the structured record fields, writer/readers, repair-push behavior and public-content boundary.
Count external review rounds from saved verdicts by one rule and show the three recorded discrepancies.

Probe at least two of the nine recorded deliveries through the package's own test doubles and one live read-only public PR run, including record writes and native gate binding with only an FO question.
Every criterion's evidence command runs once with command, exit and output path; unavailable proof is named under Not provable now.
Add tests only for failures the corpus or probe shows; keep the change inside the four permitted files.
Check the chain and batch overlaps; preserve sibling ownership.
Retain evidence, remove the local probe worktree and scratch, keep the branch, and commit only this task's state paths.
Claim a green live delivery, execute product acceptance, begin implementation, alter a real PR/gate or deploy.
